caption: Supplementary Fig. 8 | Along-track moisture and its local seasonal background. a,c, Observed (solid) and climatological (dashed) means of native 700-hPa specific humidity (g kg⁻¹; a) and RH (%; c). b,d, Observed-minus-climatology anomalies in g kg⁻¹ and RH percentage points. Blue circles mark D→E and orange squares E→F. Samples follow actual centres at nine six-hour lags from −24 to +24 h. Climatology is the native-grid 1991–2020 month-by-UTC mean, evaluated at each position before averaging over 200–800 km. The fields , ,  and  share observed/climatological pressure-quality support; temporal climatology coverage and original-area coverage each require 90%. Native  is distinct from the 700/500-hPa RH mean in the principal diagnostics. Shading gives pointwise 95% percentiles from a common bank of 2,000 resamples of all 2,340 main-sample SIDs. Observed, background and anomaly means share valid cells and SIDs within each lag; support can vary between lags. Source tables provide actual counts and all four linear fields.
